name: How should a homeowner prepare their garage before tile installation begins?

mainEntity.name: How should a homeowner prepare their garage before tile installation begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before installation begins, the entire garage floor must be cleared of vehicles, storage bins, tools, and workbenches. You should measure your space, inspect the concrete for standing water issues, and make arrangements for alternative parking and storage for at least a week. If you have permanent base cabinets or water heaters, you will need to decide whether the tile should terminate around them or if fixtures need temporary lifting. Having a single point of contact who inspects the slab beforehand helps clarify these logistics before work starts.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear out all vehicles and stored belongings, plan alternative parking for roughly a week, and decide whether wall cabinets or water heaters need tile run underneath.
